run.command_intent: Run the hreflang SEO gap check.

artifacts.description: Local or fetched source inspected by the gap checker.
Target, approval class, timing, and errors.

limits: Checks are structural evidence and heuristics, not ranking or compliance guarantees.
No schema generation or external mutation is performed.

findings.summary: No hreflang alternate links were observed; this is not a defect without an international targeting requirement.

verification: Input source and check mode are recorded.
Raw input and run metadata were preserved when the source could be read.
Run seo-quality-gate before treating findings as ready.
